arxiv-1712-04331.title: Holographic conductivity of holographic superconductors with higher order corrections
arxiv-1712-04331.creator: Ahmad Sheykhi, Afsoon Ghazanfari, Amin Dehyadegari
arxiv-1712-04331.description: Abstract We analytically as well as numerically disclose the effects of the higher order correction terms in the gravity and in the gauge field on the properties of s s -wave holographic superconductors. On the gravity side, we consider the higher curvature Gauss-Bonnet corrections and on the gauge field side, we add a quadratic correction term to the Maxwell Lagrangian.

These include transverse-momentum ( q T q_{T} ) logarithms, logarithms involving heavy-quark or electroweak gauge boson masses, and small- x x logarithms.

PSR B1259–63/LS 2883 is a gamma-ray binary system consisting of a pulsar in an eccentric orbit around a bright O e stellar-type companion star that features a dense circumstellar disc. arxiv-2409-15216.title: FLeNS: Federated Learning with Enhanced Nesterov-Newton Sketch
arxiv-2409-15216.creator: Sunny Gupta, Mohit Jindal, Pankhi Kashyap, Pranav Jeevan, Amit Sethi
arxiv-2409-15216.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Sunny Gupta, Mohit Jindal, Pankhi Kashyap, Pranav Jeevan, Amit Sethi. Federated learning faces a critical challenge in balancing communication efficiency with rapid convergence, especially for second-order methods. While Newton-type algorithms achieve linear convergence in communication rounds, transmitting full Hessian matrices is often impractical due to quadratic complexity. We introduce Federated Learning with Enhanced Nesterov-Newton Sketch (FLeNS), a novel method that harnesses both the acceleration capabilities of Nesterov’s method and the dimensionality reduction benefits of Hessian sketching.

arxiv-2501-17941.title: Sufficient conditions for unbounded superradiance in black hole spacetimes sourced by nonlinear electrodynamics
arxiv-2501-17941.creator: Marco A. A. de Paula, Luiz C. S. Leite, Luís C. B. Crispino
arxiv-2501-17941.description: Abstract Recently, it has been reported that black holes (BHs) sourced by nonlinear electrodynamics (NED) can trigger unbounded superradiance, i. e., the total absorption cross section — the ratio between the absorbed flux and the incident flux of the wave — can be negative and unbounded from below.

arxiv-2506-19694.title: UltraAD: Fine-Grained Ultrasound Anomaly Classification via Few-Shot CLIP Adaptation
arxiv-2506-19694.creator: Yue Zhou, Yuan Bi, Wenjuan Tong, Wei Wang, Nassir Navab, Zhongliang Jiang
arxiv-2506-19694.description: Abstract Precise anomaly detection in medical images is critical for clinical decision-making. While recent unsupervised or semi-supervised anomaly detection methods trained on large-scale normal data show promising results, they lack fine-grained differentiation, such as benign vs. malignant tumors. Additionally, ultrasound (US) imaging is highly sensitive to devices and acquisition parameter variations, creating significant domain gaps in the resulting US images.

pmc-12841463.creator: Diana V. Félix-Alcalá, Mirian A. González-Ayón, Lizbeth A. Manzanares-Guevara, Alexei F. Licea-Navarro, Eugenio R. Méndez, Angel Licea-Claverie
pmc-12841463.description: This study presents the development and evaluation of multifunctional, thermoresponsive nanogels based on poly(N-vinylcaprolactam-co-N-vinylpyrrolidone) (P(NVCL-co-NVP)) with a poly(ethylene glycol) methyl ether methacrylate (PEGMA) shell and galactose (GAL) targeting ligand for colon cancer therapy. Randomised controlled trials (RCT) and comparative cohort studies comparing outcomes between planned implant removal and retention were considered.

pmc-13354546.title: Fall and Spring Staging in a Refugia‐Dependent Migratory Snake
pmc-13354546.creator: Andrew C. Jesper, Michael J. Dreslik, Scott A. Eckert
pmc-13354546.description: Animals reliant on seasonal refugia face timing challenges because refugia can act as temporal bottlenecks that limit access to vital resources including food, mates, and suitable thermal conditions. Consequently, the timing of entry into and exit from refugia carries fitness consequences, particularly for temperate migratory reptiles that must balance the threat of low winter temperatures against short active seasons.
